entries.title: Example entry: an open item carried from the page
entries.excerpt: Entries with `- **Status:** open` are pulled to the top of `vault/INDEX.md`, so the open loops from the paper notebook stay visible.

entries.title: Example entry: how a notebook page gets logged
entries.excerpt: This entry exists so the index has something to chew on. Delete it once real pages are logged.

entries.title: Why ids instead of names
entries.excerpt: Machines get called different things by different people. One id per machine means `notebook.js search --machine BROTHER-01` returns every page you ever

entries.title: Conventions
entries.excerpt: - Notebook ids are short and sortable: `NB-01`, `NB-02`, ... - Page numbers are per-notebook, starting at 1 on the first right-hand page.
